title: Step 1 - Add Javascript and jQuery
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Create game.js, link it, then add jQuery and verify both loaded.

concepts.heading: Why an external file
points: All game logic lives in a separate JS file linked from the HTML, keeping markup and behaviour apart.

concepts.heading: Verifying the setup
points: A temporary alert() in game.js proves the file is linked: reload the page and the dialog should appear. Remove or comment it out afterwards.
Add the jQuery library (CDN script tag) before the game script so $ exists when the game file runs.
Test jQuery in DevTools: typing $("h1") in the console should print a jQuery object wrapping the h1; if jQuery did not load you get a '$ is not defined' error.

concepts.heading: Script tag placement
points: (Extra) Put both script tags at the end of body so elements exist when the code runs, and jQuery's tag must come first.

code_examples.caption: Script tags at end of body

task.name: Link JS and jQuery
steps: Add a script tag for it in index.html
Add alert("hello") and confirm it fires, then delete it
Add the jQuery CDN script tag above game.js
In the console run $("h1") and confirm a jQuery object is returned
task.expected_result: Page loads with no console errors and $("h1") works.
task.reference_repo_path: Section 20 - Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game/script.js

pitfalls: jQuery script placed after game.js causes '$ is not defined'.
The reference repo names the file script.js; the lecture uses game.js. Either works if the link matches.
